mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_turn (turn_id, session_id, seq, user_input, state_before, status) VALUES (#{turnId}, #{sessionId}, #{seq}, #{userInput}, CAST(#{stateBeforeJson} AS jsonb), 'RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_turn SET final_reply = #{finalReply}, route_action = #{routeAction}, route_target = #{routeTarget}, node_path = CAST(#{nodePathJson} AS jsonb), state_after = CAST(#{stateAfterJson} AS jsonb), status = #{status}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, latency_ms = #{latencyMs}, finished_at = now() WHERE turn_id = #{turnId}
mapper.select: SELECT turn_id, seq, user_input, final_reply, route_action, route_target, node_path::text AS node_path, status, error_msg, latency_ms, started_at FROM flow_turn WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY seq

SELECT turn_id, session_id, seq, user_input, final_reply, route_action, route_target, node_path::text AS node_path, state_before::text AS state_before, state_after::text AS state_after, status, error_msg, latency_ms, started_at FROM flow_turn WHERE turn_id = #{turnId}
